observations.quote: As of December 31, 2023, we operated 10 data centers with approximately 70 MW of active power.
As of December 31, 2024, we operated 32 data centers with approximately 360 MW of active power.
As of December 31, 2025, we operated 43 data centers with over 850 MW of active power.
Expanded active power by nearly 500 MWs to reach 1.5 GW
As of December 31, 2025, our total contracted power capacity was approximately 3.1 GW, which we expect to deploy over future periods.
